Bug_Title: Se: The readResolve method must not be declared as a static method. (SE_READ_RESOLVE_IS_STATIC)
Bug_Details:
In order for the readResolve method to be recognized by the serialization
mechanism, it must not be declared as a static method.
Bug_Explanation: The'readResolve' method is declared as a static method in the 'BugClass' class. This is a bug as per the rule 'Se: The readResolve method must not be declared as a static method. (SE_READ_RESOLVE_IS_STATIC)'
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method which internally calls the readResolve method. Since readResolve is a static method, it will not be called during object de-serialization and hence the deserialized object will not be the same as the original one. Therefore, the assertNotEquals method will fail.
